counterexample: Adversarial case considered: an agent copies a complete application hidden in the seed/assets, /solution, /tests or a prior /app Git commit. The inspected seed/assets contain no implementation, both forbidden roots are absent, and the actual image build creates a new root commit containing only .gitkeep, so no such answer source was found. Conforming alternative considered: an author selects its own frontend tools, API layout and examples or uses allowed CDN assets; the public notes permit those choices, and these requirements/dependencies are not treated as leaked application code.
